**Title:** Saint Martin Ship Ticket Bangladesh | Price, Schedule & Booking | ShipTickets.bd
**Description:** Compare Saint Martin ship tickets, prices, schedules, cabins and facilities from Cox's Bazar. Check the latest verified information before booking.
**Last reviewed:** 5 October 2026

Saint Martin ship tickets, made simple. ShipTickets.bd is a Bangladesh-focused information and human-assisted booking website for Saint Martin ship tickets from Cox's Bazar. Compare ships, check fares, verify schedules and contact our support team on WhatsApp or phone before you travel.

### Ship Directory - [https://www.shiptickets.bd/saint-martin-ship](https://www.shiptickets.bd/saint-martin-ship)

**Title:** Saint Martin Ships Directory: Fares, Classes & Schedule | ShipTickets.bd
**Description:** Compare the four Saint Martin passenger ships serving Cox's Bazar — MV Karnafuly Express, MV Baro Awlia, Keari Sindbad and Keari Cruise & Dine — with clear operating-status notes.

Ships operating Cox's Bazar to Saint Martin:

1. **MV Karnafuly Express (কর্ণফুলী এক্সপ্রেস)** — [karnafuly-express](https://www.shiptickets.bd/saint-martin-ship/karnafuly-express)
   - Operator: Karnafuly Shipbuilding & Engineering
   - Status: Seasonal confirmation required — 2026-2027 season opens 1 November 2026
   - One-way fare from: ৳1,800 | Round-trip from: ৳3,500
   - Classes: Lavender Economy Seat (৳1,800 / ৳3,500), Marigold Economy Seat (৳1,800 / ৳3,500), Open Deck (৳2,100 / ৳4,000), Gladiolus Business Seat (৳2,600 / ৳5,000), Lilac Lounge (৳2,700 / ৳5,300), Chrysanthemum Lounge (৳2,900 / ৳5,600)
   - Cabins: Single Cabin — 1 passenger, ৳3,300 / ৳6,500; Twin Cabin — 2 passengers, ৳7,000 / ৳13,000; VIP Cabin — Private cabin, ৳8,500 / ৳16,000; VVIP Cabin — Private cabin, ৳10,500 / ৳20,000
   - Facilities: Indoor seating, Open deck, Premium lounge seating, Restaurant / food service, Washrooms, Prayer room, Cabin accommodation, Passenger service areas
   - Journey: Approx. 5 hours (seasonal — confirm for your sailing)
   - Departure: Morning departure (seasonal — confirm exact time)
   - Check-in: Arrive before the published departure time; final check-in is confirmed on your ticket
   - Last reviewed: 5 October 2026

2. **MV Baro Awlia (বারো আওলিয়া)** — [baro-awlia](https://www.shiptickets.bd/saint-martin-ship/baro-awlia)
   - Operator: Baro Awlia Shipping
   - Status: Seasonal confirmation required — 2026-2027 season opens 1 November 2026
   - One-way fare from: ৳1,800 | Round-trip from: ৳3,500
   - Classes: Main Deck Seat (৳1,800 / ৳3,500), Sun Deck Seat (৳1,800 / ৳3,500), Panorama Business Chair (৳2,100 / ৳4,000), Riviera Business Chair (৳2,100 / ৳4,000), Mozarat Chair (৳2,200 / ৳4,300)
   - Cabins: Bunker Bed — 2-person category, ৳4,100 / ৳8,000; Deluxe Cabin — 2 persons, ৳7,000 / ৳13,000; Family Bunker Cabin — 4 persons, ৳8,500 / ৳16,000; VIP Cabin — 2 persons, ৳8,500 / ৳16,000; VVIP Cabin — 2 persons, ৳10,500 / ৳20,000
   - Facilities: AC seating (selected categories), Open-view deck seating, Indoor seating, Common washrooms, Attached washroom (selected cabins), Cabin accommodation, Food / restaurant service, Passenger service areas
   - Journey: Approx. 2 hours
   - Departure: Date and tide dependent — published schedules vary by sailing date
   - Check-in: Approx. 1 hour before departure (follow the time printed on your ticket)
   - Last reviewed: 5 October 2026

3. **Keari Sindbad (কেয়ারী সিন্দবাদ)** — [keari-sindbad](https://www.shiptickets.bd/saint-martin-ship/keari-sindbad)
   - Operator: KEARI Tours & Services Ltd.
   - Status: Seasonal confirmation required — 2026-2027 season opens 1 November 2026
   - One-way fare from: ৳1,825 | Round-trip from: ৳3,500
   - Classes: Main Deck 1st Floor (৳1,825 / ৳3,500, approx. 160 seats), Open Deck 2nd Floor (৳2,075 / ৳4,000, approx. 144 seats), Bridge Deck 2nd Floor (৳2,325 / ৳4,500, approx. 42 seats)
   - Cabins: No private cabin inventory is published for this vessel
   - Facilities: Passenger seating, Open viewing areas, Canteen / food service, Audio facilities, Passenger security arrangements, Life rafts, Life jackets, Life buoys, Rescue boat
   - Journey: Not published as a fixed duration; varies by date, route, weather, sea conditions and tide
   - Departure: Previously published 7:00 AM with 6:45 AM reporting (reference only, confirm for your travel date)
   - Check-in: Confirm the reporting time shown on your ticket for your sailing date
   - Specifications: Built by Western Marine Shipyard, launched 22 January 2004. Length 34.10 m, beam 7.62 m, depth 2.77 m, total published seating 346 passengers.
   - Last reviewed: 5 October 2026

4. **Keari Cruise & Dine (কেয়ারী ক্রুজ অ্যান্ড ডাইন)** — [keari-cruise-dine](https://www.shiptickets.bd/saint-martin-ship/keari-cruise-dine)
   - Operator: Keari Tours & Services Ltd.
   - Status: Needs confirmation — 2026-2027 season opens 1 November 2026
   - One-way fare from: ৳2,075 | Round-trip from: ৳4,000
   - Classes: Exclusive Lounge (৳2,075 / ৳4,000), Coral Lounge (৳2,325 / ৳4,500), Pearl Lounge (৳2,575 / ৳5,000)
   - Cabins: Published Keari information focuses on Pearl, Coral and Exclusive lounge seating. No private cabin inventory is published for this vessel — confirm current availability before booking.
   - Facilities: Air-conditioned lounges, Floating restaurant, Buffet facilities, Sky deck, Grand lobby, Conference / event facilities, Safety equipment (life rafts, life jackets, life buoys)
   - Journey: Varies by route, tide and sea conditions — use your date-specific schedule
   - Departure: Seasonal — reporting and departure time confirmed for your date
   - Check-in: Reporting time confirmed on your ticket or booking confirmation
   - Last reviewed: 5 October 2026

5. **MV Bay Cruiser 1 — retired, not operating this season**
   - Not sailing on the Cox's Bazar to Saint Martin route for the 2026-2027 season.
   - No current fare, class, schedule or facility information is published for this vessel.
   - The old `/saint-martin-ship/bay-cruiser-1` URL redirects to the current ship list.

### Ship Schedule - [https://www.shiptickets.bd/saint-martin-ship-schedule](https://www.shiptickets.bd/saint-martin-ship-schedule)

**Title:** Saint Martin Ship Schedule & Departure Times | ShipTickets.bd
**Description:** Check how to verify Saint Martin ship departure times, return schedules, check-in points and seasonal operating status.

**Current schedule status:** Seasonal confirmation required. Last reviewed: 5 October 2026

**What to confirm before travel:**
1. Departure date and reporting time
2. Designated jetty (BIWTA Nuniachhara Jetty, Cox's Bazar) and check-in counter
3. Estimated journey duration (approximately 2 hours)
4. Return sailing date and time
5. Weather or tide-related changes
6. Travel Pass and QR ticket requirements

Ship departure and return times are seasonal and operator-specific. Do not rely on an old departure time. Confirm your operator, date, jetty and reporting time before leaving for Cox's Bazar.

### Travel Pass - [https://www.shiptickets.bd/saint-martin-travel-pass](https://www.shiptickets.bd/saint-martin-travel-pass)

**Title:** Saint Martin Travel Pass & QR Ticket | ShipTickets.bd
**Description:** Learn what the Saint Martin Travel Pass and QR-coded ship ticket mean, why they matter and what to verify before travel.

**Key points:**
- The Travel Pass is required under applicable government rules for visitors to Saint Martin Island
- QR-coded tickets may be required alongside the Travel Pass
- Requirements change between seasons
- Use only valid tickets from authorized channels
- Ensure passenger names on the ticket match your ID

**Before departure:**
1. Use an authorized ticketing channel
2. Check passenger name, date, ship and route
3. Keep the QR code accessible on your phone and carry a backup
4. Ask about return sailing and check-in cut-off

---

### Travel Rules - [https://www.shiptickets.bd/saint-martin-travel-rules](https://www.shiptickets.bd/saint-martin-travel-rules)

**Title:** Saint Martin Travel Rules & Restrictions | ShipTickets.bd
**Description:** A practical guide to Saint Martin Island travel rules, visitor limits, overnight stays, environmental restrictions and ship ticket checks.

**Can I visit Saint Martin now?**
Access depends on the current government-approved season, visitor limit and operator permissions. Treat every schedule and ticket as subject to confirmation.

**Rules to verify before travel:**
- Whether the island is open for tourism in your planned month
- Daily visitor and overnight stay limits, which are set per season
- Travel Pass and QR ticket requirements
- Approved jetty and vessel list (BIWTA Nuniachhara Jetty)
- Environmental protections and restricted items
- Weather and sea-condition notices

Saint Martin is a sensitive marine environment. Follow local authority instructions, avoid single-use plastic, do not damage coral or wildlife.

### Route Guide - [https://www.shiptickets.bd/routes/coxs-bazar-to-saint-martin](https://www.shiptickets.bd/routes/coxs-bazar-to-saint-martin)

**Title:** Cox's Bazar to Saint Martin Ship | ShipTickets.bd
**Description:** Understand the Cox's Bazar to Saint Martin ship route, jetty, check-in, ticket and Travel Pass information.

**Route overview:**
During an approved tourist season, passenger vessels operate between the designated Cox's Bazar jetty and Saint Martin Island. The exact vessel, departure time and access rules can change, so confirm every detail for your travel date.

**Before leaving for the jetty:**
1. Confirm the approved jetty (BIWTA Nuniachhara Jetty) and reporting time
2. Keep your booking reference and QR code ready
3. Carry valid passenger identification where required
4. Ask about return sailing and check-in cut-off

## FAQ — quick answers

**How much is a Saint Martin ship ticket?**
Reference one-way seating fares range from ৳1,800 to ৳2,900 depending on ship and seating class, and round-trip seating fares from ৳3,000 to ৳5,600. Private cabins are quoted separately and cost more. Verify current prices before payment.

**কক্সবাজার থেকে সেন্টমার্টিন কোন জাহাজ যায়?**
MV Karnafuly Express, MV Baro Awlia, Keari Sindbad, Keari Cruise & Dine (seasonal).

**Do I need a Travel Pass for Saint Martin?**
Yes, required during tourist season. Check latest rules before travel.

**Can I book by WhatsApp?**
Yes. Share your date and passenger count. We confirm availability before payment.

**Is the fare one-way or round-trip?**
Both available. One-way = Cox's Bazar → Saint Martin. Round-trip includes return.

**What is the difference between open deck, lounge and cabin?**
Open deck = outdoor seating. Lounge = indoor seating. Cabin = private accommodation (single/twin/VIP/VVIP).

**How do I reach the jetty?**
BIWTA Nuniachhara Jetty, Cox's Bazar. Confirm the approved departure point for your sailing.

**কত টাকায় সেন্টমার্টিন জাহাজ টিকিট পাবো?**
One-way ৳1,800–৳2,900, round-trip ৳3,000–৳5,600 (reference). WhatsApp-এ বর্তমান ভাড়া নিশ্চিত করুন।
